items.title: Gorenstein rings, invertibility of the dualizing complex and openness of the Gorenstein locus
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects the equivalences between the Gorenstein property of a Noetherian ring and the invertibility of a dualizing complex, both globally and after localizing, together with the openness of the Gorenstein locus, and identifies the case where the ring itself is a dualizing complex (author lemma at source lines 3997-4014, label lemma-gorenstein). The proof (source lines 4016-4060) localizes the complex, uses uniqueness of dualizing complexes for the local criterion, spreads invertibility from a point to a principal open neighbourhood by finiteness and faithfulness of the complex to get openness, and finishes the second part by locality of dualizing complexes (proof lines 4028-4059). The openness argument is the substance. H3.
